result:
The explicitly stated or inferred needs and expectations of users, primarily elderly people and caregivers, include the need for personalized care, cognitive stimulation, social interaction, and ease of use of the robotic system. Users expressed a desire for functionalities that help them cope with loneliness, maintain cognitive abilities, and receive reminders for daily activities.

Source: "the participants pointed out that, when the robot was present, there was 'someone' to talk to, waiting for them at home, and making the environment more friendly. This made easier for them to cope with loneliness." and "the robot was very helpful to improve the users’ diet by providing reminders for snacks or meals during the day, and by recommending the type of food that the user was required to eat."

result:
The explicitly stated or inferred needs and expectations of users, primarily elderly people and caregivers, include the need for improved communication, reduced burden during night shifts, and enhanced monitoring of vital information. There is also an expectation for robots to stimulate communication among elderly individuals and assist caregivers in managing their workload.

Source: "Communicative robots can stimulate elderly individuals to activate a communication link with others... Temporary responses to nurse calls by the robots may help to effectively reduce the burden on nursing care workers during the night shift... Automatic recording of vital information using robot sensors can improve the quality of nursing care work."
